en.retell.title: Shrinking Retell
en.retell.pitch: Say the same thing three times with less time each round, until it flows.
en.retell.lede: You'll tell the same content three times, and every round is shorter. With less time you stop planning sentences and start pulling them from memory. That's how fluency grows.
en.retell.storyDesc: Listen to a short everyday story, then retell it in your own words.
en.retell.selfDesc: Pick a topic from your own life and tell it three times.
en.retell.noHistory: No results yet. Your first drill will show up here.
en.retell.writing: Writing a short story for you
en.retell.writingHint: The local AI can take up to a minute the first time.
en.retell.builtIn: The AI couldn't write a story this time ({err}), so here is one from the built-in set.
en.retell.builtInPlain: The AI's story didn't come out right, so here is one from the built-in set.
en.retell.listenFirst: Listen first, as many times as you like. Then you'll retell the story three times without looking at it.
en.retell.planHint: Don't memorize sentences. Remember what happens, then tell it your way.
en.retell.pickLede: Choose something you could talk about for a minute or two.
en.retell.selfHint: Take ten seconds to plan: where, who, what happened, how you felt. Then tell it three times.
en.retell.ready: Tap Start and begin talking. Recording stops when the time runs out.
en.retell.noMic: This browser can't use the microphone here. Type your retelling below.
en.retell.recording: Recording. Keep talking until the time runs out.
en.retell.heardNothing: Didn't catch anything. Try again a bit closer to the mic, or type instead.
en.retell.asrFailed: Speech recognition isn't working right now. Type your retelling instead.
en.retell.typeHint: Typing skips the speed and pause measurements.
en.retell.typedNote: This round was typed, so speed and pauses weren't measured.
en.retell.tip.fillers: You used {n} fillers (mostly "{word}"). When you need a second, pause silently instead.
en.retell.tip.pauses: Your longest pause was {s} s. If a word won't come, use a simpler one and keep going.
en.retell.tip.points: You skipped: {list}. Keep the main events and drop the small details.
en.retell.tip.andThen: You said "and then" {n} times. Try "after that", "so" or "later" for some variety.
en.retell.tip.default: Nice round. The next one is shorter: same content, fewer words, no planning.
en.retell.tip.end: Nice work. Retell the same content again tomorrow, or try new content at the same level.
en.retell.next: Same content, less time: {a} s → {b} s. Don't plan it again. Just say it.
en.retell.v.same: You kept about the same pace
en.retell.v.pSame: and paused as often as before
en.retell.v.pMore: but paused more often (normal when time gets short)
en.retell.v.noTiming: At least one round was typed, so speed and pauses can't be compared. Check words, fillers and key points below.
en.retell.abLede: The first 10 seconds of round 1 and round 3, back to back.
en.retell.transcripts: What you said in each round

zh.retell.title: 缩时复述
zh.retell.pitch: 同一段内容讲三遍，每遍时间更短，越讲越流利。
zh.retell.lede: 同样的内容你要讲三遍，每一轮的时间都更短。时间一紧，你就没空斟酌句子，只能直接从记忆里调出来——流利度就是这样练出来的。
zh.retell.storyDesc: 听一个日常小故事，然后用自己的话讲出来。
zh.retell.selfDesc: 选一个和你生活有关的话题，讲三遍。
zh.retell.noHistory: 还没有记录。完成第一次练习后会显示在这里。
zh.retell.writing: 正在为你写一个小故事
zh.retell.writingHint: 第一次加载本地 AI 可能需要一分钟左右。
zh.retell.builtIn: 这次 AI 没能写出故事（{err}），先用一个内置故事。
zh.retell.builtInPlain: AI 写的故事不太合格，先用一个内置故事。
zh.retell.listenFirst: 先听，想听几遍都可以。之后不看原文，把故事复述三遍。
zh.retell.planHint: 不要背句子。记住发生了什么，再用自己的方式讲出来。
zh.retell.pickLede: 选一个你能聊上一两分钟的话题。
zh.retell.selfHint: 先花十秒想一想：在哪里、和谁、发生了什么、你感觉如何。然后讲三遍。
zh.retell.topic.problem: 你解决过的一个小问题
zh.retell.ready: 点“开始说”后就开口。时间一到会自动停止录音。
zh.retell.noMic: 这个浏览器在这里无法使用麦克风。请在下面打字复述。
zh.retell.recording: 正在录音。一直说到时间结束。
zh.retell.heardNothing: 没听到声音。靠近麦克风再试一次，或者改为打字。
zh.retell.asrFailed: 语音识别暂时不可用，请改为打字复述。
zh.retell.typeHint: 打字模式不统计语速和停顿。
zh.retell.typedNote: 这一轮是打字完成的，所以没有统计语速和停顿。
zh.retell.tipLoading: 正在找一个可以说得更简洁的地方
zh.retell.tip.fillers: 你用了 {n} 个填充词（最多的是“{word}”）。需要想一想时，安静地停一下就好。
zh.retell.tip.pauses: 你最长停顿了 {s} 秒。想不起某个词时，换个简单的词，继续往下说。
zh.retell.tip.points: 你漏掉了：{list}。抓住主要情节，小细节可以省略。
zh.retell.tip.andThen: 你说了 {n} 次 “and then”。可以换成 “after that”、“so” 或 “later”。
zh.retell.tip.default: 这一轮不错。下一轮时间更短：内容不变，用词更少，不要再打草稿。
zh.retell.tip.end: 练得不错。明天再把同样的内容复述一遍，或者在同一级别换个新内容。
zh.retell.next: 内容不变，时间缩短：{a} 秒 → {b} 秒。别再重新准备，直接说。
zh.retell.v.pSame: 长停顿次数和第一轮一样
zh.retell.v.pMore: 不过长停顿变多了（时间变短时这很正常）
zh.retell.v.noTiming: 至少有一轮是打字完成的，所以无法比较语速和停顿。可以看看下面的词数、填充词和要点。
zh.retell.abLede: 第 1 轮和第 3 轮的前 10 秒，对比着听。
